bracketing_exemplars: Central Michigan QB 2026 (38, this round - two 80-grade small samples)
rationale_bullets: Noah Kim returns on a GRANTED 7TH SEASON (yr4 override, PS-explicit): 67.6/467 on 12 starts, MAC-leading 2,817 @ 61.4%, 18-11, plus 186 rush - the most PROVEN returning QB of the MAC round.
First returning EMU starting QB since 2017; HC Creighton: 'Kim will be the best QB in the MAC this year.'
MAC -10 = 57.6-equiv on full volume; full-season proven production edges CMU's small-sample upside pair.
40, M: depth behind him is thin (no-tape Stuckey, rFr Button, Yale RS McCaughey) but the grade rides the proven starter.
Both top backs expired: McMillan 78.5/178 (1,014 @ 5.7 - first Eagle with 100 rush + 100 rec in a game) and Dunlap 74.0/105 (428).
Top returning rusher is Mattord with 48 yards (67.9/6); zero returning 50-carry backs.
Grad add Bennett's real production (1,907 @ 6.1 at Coastal Carolina) is 2+ years old; his 2025 was 4 carries at Virginia Tech. James (Syracuse) RS'd LY.
14: above Ball State's 8 on Bennett's pedigree + the Kim-Bennett CCU familiarity; below Buffalo's 16 (Shelton's 244 real yards beat anything here). PS: 'won't match 25's solid production.'
data_gaps: zero recent volume anywhere in the room
